messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 page triggered — multiple ELB target failures and instance stalls observed in eu-north-1 (Stockholm). Automatic page created at 1759994321. See thread for mitigation steps. :rotating_light:

rina: ack. I'm oncall. Noted customer impact on hosted API generation endpoints. Collecting quick scope.

devon: we're seeing a wave of 503/504s for requests that hit instances in eu-north-1b around 1759994300..1759994340. ELB health checks failing with timeout. Backend process still alive but not responding to tcp.

ana_cs: CS reporting a handful of enterprise customers marked "degraded"; tickets say "requests hang then 504". One customer (acct: big-retailer) saw failures starting ~12:25 UTC.

rina: Any infra signals? IO, CPU, networking?

chao: Kernel logs on affected hosts show heavy EBS I/O stalls and repeated blk_update errors. Some instances enter IO wait and stop responding to application threads, then ELB marks them unhealthy. Here's a snippet:
```
[1759994312] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev xvda, sector 123456
[1759994320] EXT4-fs error: commit: I/O error
[1759994335] Out of memory: Kill process 1234 (python) total-vm:1024000kB
```

devon: interesting—ELB deregisters then reregisters quickly because instance recovers briefly. That churn is overloading controlplane paths.

incident-bot: AWS Case opened 9876543210 (EBS degraded performance in eu-north-1b) at 1759994350.

rina: Immediate mitigation: 1) mark the affected AZ's ASG to not scale up to avoid launching new instances on noisy EBS pool (set desired=0 for the problematic ASG subpool), 2) drain and replace unhealthy instances with instances using gp3 (provisioned IOPS) in a different AZ, 3) reduce Route53 TTL and set a weighted routing policy to shift 60% of traffic to eu-west-1 temporarily. Thoughts?

chao: Agree. Also recommend detaching the EBS volumes and reattach to warm standby hosts after snapshotting if AWS suggests volume replacement. I'll snapshot first.

devon: I'll start replacing nodes in eu-north-1b with instances in 1a and 1c; provisioning with gp3 and higher iops. Starting at 1759994370.

ana_cs: Draft status update: "We are investigating elevated API errors in eu-north-1. Engineers are replacing impacted hosts and shifting traffic. We will update in 15 minutes." Posting after you confirm plan.

incident-bot: Status -> investigating. Noted AWS case 9876543210 in progress.

chao: Snapshot created for volumes attached to three affected instances at 1759994382. Starting detach/reattach workflow to standby hosts now.

devon: Rolling drain started on ASG eu-north-1b-svc-api-pool at 1759994390. Replacing 3 instances at a time to limit blast radius.

rina: I'll prepare weighted Route53 change: shift 60% traffic to eu-west-1 as standby, leave 40% to eu-north-1 to allow progressive validation. Reduce TTL from 60 -> 30s. Jaya on DNS is out so I'm doing it.

devon: After first replacements, error rate down from 18% -> 7% in eu-north overall. But we still see spikes when ELB rebalances.

ana_cs: Customer big-retailer confirms partial recovery: "Most requests succeed now, occasional spikes remain." They're asking for ETA and whether retries will fix client errors.

rina: Tell them retries with backoff should help; we are applying weighted failover to reduce their exposure and will reach out if we do a full regional failover.

aws-support: (automated) We've detected elevated storage backend latency in eu-north-1b. Engineers working on replacing affected EBS backend hardware. Case 9876543210.

chao: AWS asked for fio logs and attestations of volume config — provided at 1759994415. Also sending dmesg and iostat.

devon: Noted that some Dedicated customers have reserved capacity pinned to eu-north-1. For those tenants, we can push per-tenant route overrides to direct them to eu-west-1 standby pools. I'll coordinate with product to identify P1 tenants.

rina: Do that for the three P1 tenants in the queue. Keep it manual and reversible.

incident-bot: Update: mitigation in progress -> partial_degradation. Handoff scheduled in 30m if unresolved.

chao: One more thing — ELB connection tracking entries remain for closed backends and cause active retries on the frontdoor. I'm purging stale connections at the edge and restarting the ELB agent where possible. That reduces duplicate slow requests.

devon: Per-tenant routing update pushed for tenant: fintech-ops at 1759994452; traffic now directed to eu-west-1 fallback. Observed error rate for fintech-ops drop to <1% after DNS TTL propagation.

rina: Great. CS, send note to P1 tenants about fallback and offer assistance for any session-state migrations.

ana_cs: Doing that now. Template: "We've routed your traffic to a standby region due to storage performance issues in eu-north-1b. Please let us know if you need assistance re-seeding caches or warm-up guidance."

aws-support: Update at 1759994478: root cause likely EBS host-level hardware degradation affecting a subset of physical volumes in eu-north-1b. Replacement of disks underway. ETA unknown but remedial actions in progress.

devon: Given AWS work, recommend we keep weighted routing for at least 60 minutes and maintain lower TTL. Once AWS confirms no more volume errors for 30m, we can gradually shift traffic back.

chao: Also flagged: a small number of instances failed to reattach their original ENIs after replace; I've updated our infra to recreate ENIs cleanly and reassign private IPs where necessary. That avoided DNS/IP mismatch for long-lived clients.

incident-bot: Status updated -> monitoring. Next update due in 15m.

rina: Handoff: my shift ends in ~20m. Leo, you're taking over. Summary for handoff: eu-north-1b experiencing EBS backend hardware issues causing application stalls and ELB target churn. Actions taken: snapshots + volume replacement workflow, replaced instances on gp3, weighted Route53 shift (60% eu-west-1), per-tenant routing for P1 tenants, AWS case 9876543210 open. Current status: error rate improved from 18% -> 6% region-wide; P1 tenants stable. Keep AWS case open and wait for confirmation of replaced volumes. If region error rate climbs above 12% for 10m, consider region-wide failover.

leo_oncall: taking handoff. Thanks rina. I'll monitor dashboards and coordinate with AWS. If AWS gives a clear ETA I'll schedule gradual shift back in 30m windows.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded -> leo_oncall at 1759994580. Incident status: monitoring.

devon: Creating post-incident stub: "eu-north-1b EBS host degradation caused intermittent instance stalls and ELB target churn; mitigated with volume replacement, gp3 relaunch, and weighted DNS shift; per-tenant failover used for P1 tenants." Will expand after closure.

ana_cs: I'll follow up customers we've rerouted to confirm they see stable performance and offer credits where applicable.

chao: I'll keep pushing AWS for the hardware replacement confirmation and will upload additional logs to the case. If AWS recommends rehoming instances to new hosts, we'll schedule controlled reboots.

rina: Good work. Keep updates succinct here. :thumbsup:
